fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls, NPC undressing and optional OCum integration. v0.33.0 adds an optional Procedural Penis Animations bridge based on Accurate Penetration's public SKSE API, including per-stage penetration-target observation, deduplication and multiplayer transport. Remote target application remains isolated pending a supported PPA target setter.
